verses.1: After six days, Jesus took Peter, James, and John, his brothers, and led them to a high mountain by himself. There, he revealed himself to them.
verses.2: And he was also transformed before them. His face became like the sun, and his eyelids became white like light.
verses.3: And behold, Moses and Elia appeared to them, gathering them along with him.
verses.4: Then Peter replied to Jesus, “Lord, it is good for us to be here. If you wish, I will make three scenes: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elias.”
verses.5: While he was still speaking, suddenly, bright light appeared above them. And a voice from the sky said, “This is my beloved son. I have glorified him. Listen to him.”
verses.6: And when the disciples heard this, they fell to their faces in fear.
verses.7: And Jesus came near to them, looked at them, and said, “Get up, do not be afraid.”
verses.8: But when they opened their eyes, they saw nothing, except for Jesus alone.
verses.9: And as they were descending from the mountain, Jesus told them, “Do not say that sign until the Son of Man rises from the dead.”
verses.10: And the disciples asked him, saying, “Why do the scribes say that Elyas must go first?”
verses.11: But the one who answered said, “Elias will come and restore everything back to its rightful place.”
verses.12: I tell you that Elyas has already arrived. They did not accept him, but instead did whatever they wanted with him. In the same way, the son of man will also suffer under their rule.
verses.13: Then the disciples said to each other that it was about John the Baptist.
verses.14: And when he came before the crowd, a man who was pregnant approached him.
verses.15: And he said, “Lord, have mercy on my son; he is suffering greatly. He gets burned by fire many times, and also gets soaked in water many times.”
verses.16: And I also sent him to your disciples, but they were unable to cure him.
verses.17: Then Jesus replied, “Oh, you wicked and perverse people! How long will I remain with you? How long will I endure your cruelty? Bring him to me.”
verses.18: And Jesus forgave him. Then the demon left him. From that moment on, the boy was healed.
verses.19: Then, the disciples who were with Jesus said privately, “Why couldn’t we get rid of them?”
verses.20: And he said to them, “Because of your lack of faith, I say to you: If you truly have faith like a drop of dew, then go over that mountain. After you cross it, everything will be possible for you.”
verses.22: Then, while they were together in Galilee, Jesus said to them, “The Son of Man will be handed over into the hands of people.”
verses.23: And they will also destroy him. On the third day, he will be raised from the dead. They will be extremely sad.
verses.24: When they arrived at Kafarnaum, those who received the bread said to Peter, “Does your teacher not finish the bread?”
verses.25: He said, “Naí. And when he entered the house, Jesus asked him, ‘What do you think, Simon? Do the kings of the earth take taxes from whom?’ From their own sons or from others.”
verses.26: When he asked, “What is the meaning of these words?” Jesus replied, “Then you are truly free.”
verses.27: So, in order not to deceive them, put an angler into the sea first. Then, when the fish starts to swim towards the surface, open its mouth and you will find a treasure there. Take that treasure for yourselves instead of me.
